- **#8 (e0 avg_pool | e2 nor_conv_1x1):** A 1×1 on edge 2 is a narrow condition. The pooling–1×1 receptive-field argument cuts both ways, so the effect is unlikely to be consistent across datasets.

- **#19 (e2 skip | e1 none):** The direction depends on what skip replaces on edge 2, so the interaction sign is ambiguous.

- e2 nor_conv_3x3 | e5 none → lower (node 2 is cut off from the output, so the edit has no effect)
- e2 nor_conv_3x3 | e0 none → lower (node 1 is zero, so edge 2 has nothing to transform)
- e5 none | e3 none → lower (removing edge 5 leaves only edge 4 feeding the output, so the cell nearly collapses)
- e0 none | e1 none → lower (with edge 1 gone, removing edge 0 cuts off both intermediate nodes)
